claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won the Oscar for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026 for directing the film One Battle After Another.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was held on March 15, 2026.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Chloé Zhao was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Hamnet.
Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Marty Supreme.
Joachim Trier was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sentimental Value.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards for Sinners.
One Battle After Another won six awards at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson noted in his acceptance speech the honor of being recognized among his fellow nominees.
